song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C These are the days of Elijah, .G D G Declaring the word of the Lord, . G C And these are the days of Your servant, Moses, .G D G Righteousness being restored. . Bm Em And though these are the days of great trials, . C D Of famine and darkness and sword, . G C Still, we are the voice in the desert crying, . G D G "Prepare ye the way of the Lord!"
[C1] . Dsus D G C Behold He comes, riding on the clouds, . G D Shining like the sun at the trumpet call. . Dsus D G C So lift your voice, it's the year of jubilee, . G D G And out of Zion's hill, salvation comes.
[V2] . G C And these are the days of Ezekiel, . G D G The dry bones becoming as flesh. . G C And these are the days of Your servant, David, . D D G Rebuilding the temple of praise. . Bm Em And these are the days of the harvest, . C D The fields are as white in the world. . G C And we are the laborers in Your vineyard, . G D G Declaring the word of the Lord!
[B1] . G C There's no one like Jehovah, there's no one like Jehovah, . G D There's no one like Jehovah, there's no one like Jehovah.
song.title: Days of Elijah
song.author: Robin Mark
